retrievalProfile.description: A three-panel vertical portrait layout featuring high-contrast photography, a top-aligned typographic header, and individual script signatures over each subject.

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured graphic composition divided into three equal vertical octagonal-cornered panels against a black background, topped by a white rectangular header containing bold sans-serif text and a tracklist.
coreVisualRelationships: Three vertical portrait panels anchored by a horizontal header
High-contrast lighting on subjects against deep black backgrounds
White script signatures contrasting with the dark panel interiors
Bold magenta and black typography in the header section
coreInvariants: Three-panel vertical triptych structure with beveled corners

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects positioned in the lower half of their respective vertical panels, scaled to head-and-shoulder portraits.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, large-scale title text in the top-left corner of the white header.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left title, across the tracklist, then down through the three individual portraits from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant black negative space above the subjects within the panels to accommodate signatures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white header and black panels; saturated magenta for visual pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy grotesque sans-serif and fluid cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses ultra-bold, tightly tracked sans-serif
Signatures are rendered in a continuous, fluid monoline script
Tracklist uses a clean, medium-weight sans-serif with wide tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly kerned 'S' and 'U' in display text to create a solid block effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact bold sans-serif for information paired with personal, organic script for identity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and density of the primary display text.
Approximates the fluid, hand-written quality of the signatures.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a white rectangular header at the top. Below it, place three identical vertical black panels with beveled (octagonal) corners. Inside each panel, place a high-contrast portrait of a different person in the bottom third, facing slightly inward.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold magenta sans-serif text in the top-left of the header. Add a black sans-serif tracklist to the right. Place white script signatures in the upper half of each black panel.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly three vertical panels?
Do the panels have beveled corners?
Is the header text bold and primarily magenta?
Are there white script signatures above the portraits?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (magenta to other bright hues)
postGenerationChecks: Check for three distinct vertical panels
Ensure header text is legible and bold
Confirm signatures are white and script-based
Check for high-contrast lighting on subjects
recipe.reuseFormula: Triptych + Beveled Panels + Header Tracklist + Script Signatures
